problem: The canonical Instagram Reel passed all Mira media gates but the publisher failed before provider write because INSTAGRAM_GET_USER_INFO was called with the legacy Instagram Business user id as a direct node lookup.
root_cause: The Composio Instagram Login connection exposes a connection node id and a separate Graph user_id. Identity preflight queried the legacy Graph id directly and then collapsed id/user_id into one field, causing a 400 even though the canonical bedrijfsgeheugen.nl BUSINESS connection was active.
prevention: Resolve the authenticated Instagram account with ig_user_id='me', read both id and user_id, validate user_id against the canonical Graph ID, validate username independently, require BUSINESS account type, and use the same selected canonical connection for publish and readback.
